translation.name: Biblica® Se aɖeke mebla Biblia zazã o Agbenya La™

content: David ƒe ha na hɛnɔ la.

content.text: O! Yehowa, ɖem tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe asi me
eye dzɔ ŋunye le ŋutsu ŋutasẽlawo ta,
ame siwo ɖoa nu vɔ̃ɖiwo ɖe woƒe dzi me,
eye wodoa aʋa gbe sia gbe.
Wonyre woƒe aɖewo wole ɖaɖam abe da tɔ ene,
eye da ƒe aɖi le woƒe nuyiwo ŋu. Sela
O! Yehowa, ɖem tso ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe asi me,
dzɔ nye agbe ŋu le ŋutsu ŋutasẽlawo ta,
ame siwo ɖo be woaɖe afɔ le tenye.
Dada tre mɔ da ɖe ɣaɣlaƒe nam,
woɖo ɖɔ, keke eme da ɖi nam
eye wotre azãwo da ɖe nye toƒe. Sela
O! Yehowa, megblɔ na wò be,
“Wòe nye nye Mawu.”
See, o Yehowa,
se nye nublanuiɣli.
O! Aƒetɔ Yehowa, nye Ɖela sesẽ,
ame si ɖɔ gakuku nam le aʋakpegbe.
O! Yehowa, mègana ame vɔ̃ɖiwo ƒe didi nava eme na wo o,
eye mègana woƒe ɖoɖowo nadze edzi na wo o,
ne menye nenema o la, woanɔ dadam. Sela
Na fukpekpe si ame siwo ɖe to ɖem
ƒe nuyiwo he vɛ la, nanye tsyɔ woƒe ta dzi.
Na dzoka xɔxɔwo nadza ɖe wo dzi;
wonetsɔ wo ƒu gbe ɖe dzo me
kple ʋe globowo me, eye womegafɔ akpɔ gbeɖe o.
Ŋutsu ameŋugblẽlawo megali ke ɖe anyigba dzi o,
eye gbegblẽ neva ŋutsu ŋutasẽlawo dzi.
Menya be Yehowa tsoa afia na ame dahewo,
eye wòxɔa nya ɖe hiãtɔwo nu.
Ame dzɔdzɔewo akafu wò ŋkɔ vavã,
eye dzi dzɔdzɔetɔwo anɔ ŋkuwò me ɖaa.
